entries.value: "User sound-kit store (SQLite store at ~/.base-studio-code/sounds.db) for base-studio-code (#3080, epic #3071) — the synthesis-first audio library (primitives + voices + cues), a thin sound-specific shim over the shared bsc-json-store (#2158), reachable from the Tauri app's sound bridge and the session-facing `bsc sound` CLI."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# The core lib (no Tauri, no SQLite) so the tiny CLI reuses it without dragging the whole desktop app
# in. The hyphenated package name maps to the `bsc_sound` crate name.
sections.name: [build-dependencies]

lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# The shared verbatim-JSON-per-id store + CLI scaffold (#2158) — this crate supplies only the
# sound-kit nouns + lean `list` fields via a CliSpec.
# Shared CLI scaffold (#1762): `CmdDoc` for the per-command help catalog + `resolve_store_path`.
# Base-dir resolution for the default release-store root (~/.base-studio-code/sound-kits, #3371).
# Content hashing for the release store's id@version integrity (#3371) — the same version `bsc-ui`'s
# twin store locks, so this adds no new dependency to the workspace graph.
